pages.title: Lunch in Reserve
pages.text: A filled sack supports eating without constant item switching.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain Sweet Tooth from Gum Worm for the sack. Drag food onto it; it stores hunger value and spends its reserve when the carrier is hungry. An empty finished sack alone does not complete this.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Fill a Sack of Sating and let it feed you automatically. Obtain Sweet Tooth from Gum Worm for the sack. Drag food onto it; it stores hunger value and spends its reserve when the carrier is hungry. An empty finished sack alone does not complete this.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Bind a Biome Treat and finish local Crucible conversion. Craft the sack from Sweet Tooth and drag food onto it; it feeds a hungry carrier. Eat a Biome Treat while fully starving in the desired biome, toss it into the crucible and fulfill all requests including its final rare item.
